metadata.description: Per-environment flash and RAM build-size budgets for protoArtoo firmware
notes: Flash: binary image size (.bin file) to fit in the OTA partition (from partitions/*.csv app0/app1 size field)
RAM: static allocation (.data + .bss sections from linker via size -A), not heap or PSRAM
dram_limit_bytes: total DRAM available per platform (hardware constant from ESP-IDF linker scripts; artoo-esp32=124580B, esp32-p4=327680B)
Budgets set with deliberate headroom to prevent reflexive raises on legitimate commits
Env-to-platform classification in 'platforms' registry; Makefile/slice_verify.py/check_build_budgets.py all consume it
Baseline measurements recorded with commit SHA (git cat-file -t to verify)

artoo_esp32.budget_rationale: Measured 1.57MB flash (92.1% of partition), 96.3KB RAM (77.3% of DRAM limit). Flash budget set at 1.6MB (94% of partition) with 30,848 bytes (1.97%) headroom over baseline. RAM budget at 110KB (88% of DRAM limit) leaves safety margin for stack growth.

firebeetle2_bringup.budget_rationale: First-flash bringup env with minimal source filter (src/ excluded). Baselines from hardware measurement via riscv32-esp-elf-size. Budgets set above measured values to accommodate full firmware adaptation (tracked by #188/#189).

firebeetle2.budget_rationale: Full firmware: compiles all of src/ against P4 toolchain for production deployment. Baselines from hardware measurement. Budget set above measured value to allow image growth during platform development.
